paragraphs.text: Codex-style desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: task completion, errors, questions and goals
, with configurable events, sound, style, privacy and click-to-focus. Windows & Ubuntu.
# dsh-system-notify
Codex-style desktop notifications for **DeepSeek Harness**: a toast and a sound when a task finishes
, fails, needs your input, or a goal completes — with configurable events, sounds, notification styl
e, privacy level, quiet hours and click-to-focus.
Built for **Windows 10/11** and **Ubuntu 22.04/24.04** (best-effort macOS support).
## Why not just a `notify` script?
Codex only runs a hook when a turn completes. This plugin is event-aware:
| | Codex-style notify script | dsh-system-notify |

| Turn complete | ✅ | ✅ with summary, project, duration |
| Turn error | ⚠️ manual scripting | ✅ wit

h error message/code |
| Questions / approvals | ❌ | ✅ “Input needed” / “Approval needed” |
| Goal c

ompleted / blocked | ❌ | ✅ |
| Subagent / workflow finished | ❌ | ✅ optional |
| Notification style

| ❌ | ✅ privacy / simple / standard / detailed |
| Sound selection | ❌ | ✅ system / chime / alert /

custom WAV/OGG |
| Quiet hours & cooldown | ❌ | ✅ |
| Click to focus DSH | ❌ | ✅ configurable |
| Se
ttings UI | ❌ | ✅ Settings → System Notifications |
Everything is local. No network calls, no telemetry, no data leaves the machine.
## Features
- **11 notification events** — turn complete/error/blocked/max-tokens/aborted, input needed, approva

l needed, goal complete/blocked, subagent finished, workflow finished.
- **Four styles** — privacy (

event only), simple, standard, detailed.
- **Interactive approvals** — approve or reject a tool call

directly on the toast; the outcome is returned to DSH.
- **Interactive questions** — choose a liste
d option from the toast, pick from a checklist for multi-select, or type a custom answer in an input

dialog.
- **Custom sounds per event** — upload a WAV/OGG from the settings page (stored beside the

config); separate files for normal and error events, plus the two bundled sounds.
- **Sound** — syst
em sound, two bundled original chimes, or your own file; separate normal/error sounds; volume on Ubu

ntu.
- **Delivery modes** — toast + sound, toast only, or sound only.
- **Quiet hours** — suppress n

ormal notifications overnight, optionally still notify on critical errors.
- **Rate control** — mini

mum task duration, per-event cooldown, optional subagent-session filtering.
- **Click to focus** — o
n Windows the toast uses DSH Desktop's official `dsh://open` deep link; on Ubuntu it can focus a win
dow via `wmctrl`/`xdotool`, then falls back to opening a link. The whole click action can be disable

d.
- **Agent tool (opt-in)** — `send_desktop_notification` lets the model send an explicit notificat

ion when you asked to be pinged.
- **Bilingual UI** — Chinese/English settings page; notification te

xt follows the system locale or can be forced to Chinese/English.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** —
Node built-ins and the OS notification stack.
## Notification styles
Given this event:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Style | What you see |

| **Privacy** (隐私) | Title only: `Task completed` — no session, summary, path or error details. |
|

**Simple** (简洁) | `Task completed` · `Refactor the settings page` |
| **Standard** (标准) | Title + se

ssion + summary + `demo · took 1m 12s` |
| **Detailed** (详细) | Title includes session + summary + fu
ll path + `turn 3 · took 1m 12s · code …` |
Errors are always delivered with `critical` urgency (Linux) and the error sound; privacy mode still
hides the message content.
## Requirements
### Windows

- Windows 10 (1809+) or Windows 11.
- DSH Desktop. The plugin uses:
- PowerShell 5.1 + WinRT toast A

PIs (built into Windows);
- the DSH Desktop AUMID `com.deepseek.dsh` for the toast identity (when it

is unavailable the helper falls back to other registered toast sources, ending at PowerShell);
- th

e `dsh://open` deep link (registered by DSH Desktop) for click-to-focus;
- a per-user `dsh-system-no

tify://` action protocol registered automatically for interactive approve/answer buttons.
[该节后续省略]
### Security / behaviour

- Action ids are random per interaction and validated against the live pending
set; a stale or forge

d action gets `410`.
- Interactive mode never triggers when notification style is **Privacy**, since

option labels and question text are content.
- In-flight prompts are dismissed on timeout/abort, an

d the normal Chat prompt
is opened instead.
## Privacy
- Notification content stays in process memory (the Windows payload is passed to the PowerShell help
er through an environment variable) and in the OS toast. The plugin itself writes only the config fi

le; Windows Notification Center may retain shown toasts according to OS settings.
- The config file

is written with user-only permissions where the OS supports them (`0600`).
- **Privacy style** remov
es session titles, summaries, paths, session ids and error text from the notification. The event cat
egory and sound remain. Interactive prompts are disabled in privacy style because option labels and

question text are content.
- Click URLs are validated against an allowlist (`http:`, `https:`, `dsh:

`); `file:`, `javascript:`, `ms-msdt:` and other schemes are rejected.
- HTTP routes are same-origin
only and reject a mismatched `Origin` header. Request bodies are capped at 256 KiB.
## Limitations
- Interactive approval always answers `allowed-once` or `rejected`; there is no “always allow” butto

n.
- Multiple questions in one request, or a notification daemon that hides actions, fall back to th

e Chat UI.
- macOS interactive actions are not supported; macOS gets normal notifications only.
- Wi
ndows notification volume is controlled by the system sound scheme; `sound.volume` applies to Ubuntu

only.
- Windows custom sounds must be WAV; a successful upload is stored locally and referenced by

absolute path.
- Clicking focuses the DSH window, not a specific session: DSH’s deep link is `dsh://

open`.
- Linux click/interactive support depends on `gdbus`, `dbus-monitor`, and a notification daem

on that implements the freedesktop spec; zenity is needed for text/checklist dialogs.
- The macOS pa

th is best-effort and click support requires `terminal-notifier`.
- Toast banners may be suppressed
by OS focus modes; this is expected system behaviour, not a plugin failure.
